prompt: Look at the picture and choose the statement that best describes it.
promptZh: 請看圖片，選出最符合畫面的敘述。

options.text: Some containers have been arranged in a row.
options.whyZh: 三個容器並排在展示牆下方。

options.text: A container has been placed on top of a shelf.
options.zh: 有個容器放在層架頂端。
options.whyZh: 容器都放在地面上，不在層架頂端。

options.text: A stack of newspapers is leaning against a container.
options.zh: 有一疊報紙斜靠著一個容器。
options.whyZh: 容器旁沒有堆疊或斜靠的報紙。

options.text: The lids of all the containers have been closed.
options.zh: 所有容器的蓋子都已關上。
options.whyZh: 三個容器上方都露出開口，沒有關上的蓋子。

explanationZh: 三個容器並排在展示牆下方。
evidence: Some containers have been arranged in a row.

vocabulary.note: Some containers have been arranged in a row.
